in_scope: src/app/actions.ts - Server actions (attendance, registration, admin operations)
src/app/auth/ - OAuth callback handlers (Supabase + custom STEM OAuth)
src/app/dashboard/ - User dashboard (auth + Discord membership check)
src/app/register/ - Registration flow (QR token, card linking)
src/lib/supabase/ - Supabase client configuration (anon vs admin)

technology_stack.auth: Discord OAuth + Supabase Auth + Custom STEM OAuth (PKCE)

key_security_concerns: NFC card ID spoofing in attendance recording (kiosk mode, no auth required)
Temporary registration token reuse or expiry bypass (30-min tokens)
Admin role check enforcement (is_admin boolean in member table)
Custom STEM OAuth PKCE flow implementation correctness
Force-logout-all time gate bypass (22:50-23:50 JST restriction)
Supabase RLS bypass via admin client misuse
Bearer token handling for external STEM Bot API calls
Data leakage via server action responses (Discord UIDs, PII)
